answer: Sample 8% of attestations per epoch and audit only those. A score is not carved in marble: it is rebuilt from samples every epoch. Tax 15 POA when over 60% of a key's attestations arrive from one subnet, read off the atlas entry holding subnet, first-seen epoch and graph edges. Sixteen auditors rotate per epoch from 240, so no key buys the same reviewer twice in a month. Not covered: a farm spread over subnets, or a 2-key cluster inside 400 at 8%. Cost in the visible case: 240 keys over 12 subnets owe 3,600 POA per epoch, and the comet alert fires at 3 keys in one subnet within one epoch.
